contract.objective: Parse and qualify the pinned LAMDA HD rotational/radiative and p-/o-H2 collision dataset, producing explicit isotope/state/unit/domain objects and bounded thermal line-source consistency checks.

dependencies.condition: Reuse independently admitted finite isotope/molecule interface and canonical species schema; do not rerun compiler fixtures.
Pinned 2289-byte HD source fixture with specified SHA256; citation/redistribution decision recorded.

dataset.version: LAMDA HD 2021-06-07; CDMS v2 December2011; Flower1999
dataset.read_status: Full source read and archived previously; no new download required

species.states: J0–8 exactly as file labels; vibrational label explicitly unspecified pending resolution of webpage v=1 discrepancy

inputs.provenance: MOLECULAR_AUTHORITY_20261025.md and hd_reference_check.json; primary LAMDA molformat.html/HD.html already read
inputs.licence: Public-use citation instructions observed; redistribution licence not established; resolve before vendoring dataset publicly. Citation-only/reference-based local ingestion may be planned independently.

equations.scope: Exact unit conversions; preserve source decimal strings.
Catalog precision comparison, not physical accuracy estimate.
One Maxwellian collider at temperatureT; p/o identities separate.
B multiplies profile-averaged mean specific intensity J_nu, not radiation energy density; changing convention requires explicit conversion.
phi integrates to1 over frequency; units J s^-1 m^-3 sr^-1 Hz^-1.

Thermal non-inverted populations only for positive-absorption gate. Use the same line photon energy h*nu in the thermal population ratio, Planck factor and Einstein relations for this algebra test; catalog-level versus catalog-frequency rounding is assessed separately by the35Hz gate. General population inversion may produce negative netalpha; preserve it and label inversion, never clamp.

domain.temperatures: First adapter accepts exact source nodes50/100/200K for collision validation. Off-grid interpolation is explicitly unsupported in this first unit; no implicit extrapolation or endpoint clamping.
domain.states: Nine source J-labelled levels and eight supplied lines; missing collision pairs are missing, notzero; no invented vibrational coverage.
domain.frequency: Supplied radiative frequencies only; no continuum cross sections.
not_covered: physical validation of metadata v=1 claim

outputs: Typed immutable HD level/line/collider records with original decimals, SI conversions and canonical WU isotope identity
Source/state/domain/uncertainty metadata with explicit missing-data flags
Saved parser/shape/unit/gap/detail-balance/LTE checks and one compact diagnostic artifact from saved results
REC handoff object for qualified radiative use; source citations and source-specific claims

acceptance.rule: SHA256 and2289bytes match frozen input; preserve original bibliography/version.
Exactly9levels,8lines,2distinctcolliders,18downwardpairs,3temperature nodes and54ratevalues. Every reference resolves to an admitted source level.
Original source decimal values and integer labels round-trip exactly; tolerance0 for identity/shape/decimal-preservation checks.
Use decimal arithmetic for |c*100*(E_u-E_l)-1e9*nu_GHz|<=35Hz for each supplied line.
acceptance.justification: Each printed level has9decimal places in cm^-1, allowing at most2*(0.5e-9)*c*100=29.9792458Hz in a difference; printed frequency8decimal GHz allows5Hz;35Hz covers this catalog rounding. This is not experimental uncertainty. A failure requires source-specific assessment, not tolerance enlargement.

acceptance.rule: Unit conversion factors exact; compare retained decimals/Decimal or rational forms before optional binary64 output.

For each supplied pair, collider andT node, construct upward rate with explicit g and gap; independently evaluate the reverse relation. Compare residual normalized by sum of magnitudes of both positive rate terms, tolerance128*binary64epsilon.
acceptance.justification: Numerical algebra check of few positive terms and one exponential, using stable evaluation;128ulp-scale margin is distinct from source physical uncertainty. Implementer must record conditioning and any underflow; no acceptance by clipping.

acceptance.rule: At declared thermal populations, compare j_nu-alpha_nu*B_nu using residual/(|j_nu|+|alpha_nu*B_nu|)<=128*binary64epsilon; use expm1 for Planck and stable population differences. Check Einstein degeneracy and B-convention explicitly.
acceptance.justification: Roundoff-only identity check; exclude zero/zero with explicit analytic-zero classification. Thermal noninversion scope avoids using positivity as a gate on population-inverted netabsorption.

acceptance.rule: Unspecified molecular state/collider/temperature/pair yields explicit unqualified/unsupported result; p/o rates never silently averaged; no extrapolation.

Previously checked HD J1→0 reference is retained: E/k=128.37908482940912K; A=5.442e-8s^-1; q10_pH2(100K)=2.7e-11cm3/s; q01=2.243580917662442e-11cm3/s. These are references, not a new test execution in this planning turn.

uncertainties.spectroscopy: Catalog rounding bound separated from experimental/theoretical frequency error; obtain original source uncertainty before precision claims.
uncertainties.collisions: No covariance in pinned file; original Flower1999 uncertainty/domain remains explicit.
uncertainties.metadata: HD webpage v=1 wording conflicts with J0–8 data labeling; do not resolve by assumption.

pr_plan.title: Add a pinned HD rotational and collider-data adapter
pr_plan.problem: Molecular source contracts currently have literature and scalar evidence but no verified typed adapter preserving isotope/collider/state/domain distinctions.
pr_plan.allowed_change_scope: New REC-owned bounded HD adapter, fixture/provenance reference and targeted tests; no existing physical solver modification.
steps: Reuse canonical isotope/molecule schema from WU-led compiler
Pin source bytes and preserve decimal/state metadata
Implement parser with exact shape/domain and explicit p/o collision identities
Derive upward rates and Einstein-consistent line source/absorption helper under thermal test assumptions
Execute one separately frozen targeted test unit after budget allocation; preserve raw diagnostics
Independent review and REC handoff of finite admitted coverage
pr_plan.independent_review: Fresh review of implementation, literal references, raw outputs and diagnostic rendering; reuses prior theory/source evidence.
pr_plan.failure_disposition: Report exact source row, field, model assumption or numerical condition. Preserve first failure; smallest targeted repair must retain original input/tolerance. Physical source gaps stay unqualified.

contract.claim_gate: IMPLEMENTATION_CHECKED_PINNED_HD_ROTATIONAL_SOURCE_ADAPTER only after targeted execution and independent review; no rate-network/other-species/cosmology completion.
contract.pass_next_action: Provide qualified HD level/line/collider object to REC population/emission consumers and REI integration planning; WU maps isotope identity.
contract.next_action: REC owner prepares adapter code and source-licence disposition from this contract, freezes a separate explicit finite budget before any test execution.
contract.execution_this_turn: NOT_RUN; this file is artifact-only planning from previously obtained source and reference evidence.
